label: EU(7)-PIM: propafenone, flecainide
title: Propafenone or flecainide in an older person
statement: The EU(7)-PIM list names propafenone and flecainide as potentially inappropriate medicines for older people. Propafenone: a high risk of interactions with other medicines. Flecainide: unwanted effects are more common, most of all in older adults. For both the list adds that, for most older adults, controlling the heart rate gives a better balance of benefit and harm than controlling the heart rhythm. As an alternative the list suggests a beta-blocker, but not oxprenolol, pindolol, propranolol, sotalol, nadolol or labetalol.

plain_summary: Propafenone and flecainide are heart rhythm medicines that the EU(7)-PIM list regards as potentially inappropriate for an older person, because of interactions with other medicines and more frequent unwanted effects. Ask whether the patient still takes the medicine, whether a heart specialist reviews it, and whether they have noticed any unwanted effects.

medicine_groups.name: Propafenone and flecainide
medicine_groups.note: No Australian brand is listed for propafenone, so a history would show the ingredient name. Flecainide may be shown as flecainide acetate. Tablets and injections count. Generic packs that show the ingredient name with a company name count too.

rule_for_models: Suspect a finding when a Group A medicine (propafenone or flecainide) is supplied at least once to a person with a recorded age of 65 or older. If age is missing and the medicine pattern matches, report only a possible finding and ask for the patient’s age. An age below 65 does not meet this criterion. One supply is enough, at any strength.
cannot_be_seen: Supplies alone do not establish the indication, the specialist’s plan, heart function, a past heart attack, ECG findings or kidney function. Hospital supplies and supplies from another pharmacy may be absent.
ask_the_gp: Whether this heart rhythm medicine is still needed, and when the heart rhythm, heart function and kidney function were last reviewed.
